decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD was launched only in 2018 and still has its own page, so its value is not yet resolved, and keeping a finished CD in a retailer's catalogue costs little, which makes the option worth holding open.

A release series has value that only becomes clear over several issues, the 2018 presentation shows no sign of failure yet, and keeping the series listed is cheap, so management keeps the option open while uncertainty resolves.
